name: Trakin Reel Cover
prompt: the channel's signature Reel cover formula. Vertical layout in three zones: (1) TOP ~25%: a huge 2-3 line headline in heavy condensed all-caps sans-serif, first line white, key line in bright yellow or orange (or the featured tool's brand colour), thick black outline and drop shadow, centred. (2) MIDDLE ~35%: the featured tool's app-icon as a glossy rounded-square tile with a curved white/yellow arrow pointing to a tilted, glowing screenshot card or before/after result cards showing what the tool does. (3) BOTTOM ~40%: the host, chest-up, centred, cropped by the bottom edge, friendly confident expression looking at camera, crisp and well lit with a soft rim light. Background: a rich, saturated gradient themed to the featured tool's brand colour (e.g. Claude = warm orange, ChatGPT = electric blue, WhatsApp = green, festive topics = maroon and gold with bokeh lights), with blurred tech UI panels, glow and depth. Bold, clean, premium, Indian-creator energy, everything readable at phone size.

name: Breaking Tech News
prompt: high-energy Indian tech-news YouTube look. Dark navy background with glowing red and yellow accents, subtle light streaks, a bold 'BREAKING'-style energy, strong contrast, slight glow around the subject.

name: Phone Review
prompt: premium smartphone review look. Clean dark studio gradient, the phone shown large and sharp with realistic reflections, soft blue rim light, Apple-keynote level polish, minimal clutter.

name: Versus / Comparison
prompt: head-to-head comparison. Frame split diagonally into two contrasting colour halves (red vs blue), one product on each side, a big glowing 'VS' energy in the middle behind the host, dramatic lighting.

name: Shock / Reaction
prompt: viral reaction thumbnail. Saturated orange-to-black background, exaggerated surprised host expression, arrows or circle highlights pointing at the key detail, punchy and attention-grabbing but not messy.

name: Clean Teal (Trakin)
prompt: clean cinematic look: dark teal-to-black background, minimal rounded teal cards for the media, lots of breathing room, soft teal glow, no icons or decorative lines, very high readability.

name: Deals / Money
prompt: shopping deals and price-drop look. Deep green background, gold and green accents, price-tag and discount energy, products floating with soft shadows, festive sale vibe suited to Indian audiences.

name: AI / Futuristic
prompt: futuristic AI theme. Deep purple-black background with neon violet and cyan glow, subtle circuit or particle texture, holographic feel around the media cards, sleek and modern.

name: Custom
prompt: follow the user's extra style notes closely.
